resources.string: Colour skin and hair by group

These layers represent the surfaces available in the source datasets. Structure counts include subdivisions and grouped branches, not complete physiological systems. Vessel colours are illustrative: red for systemic arteries and pulmonary veins, blue for systemic veins and pulmonary arteries. Capillaries and microscopic tissues are absent. Eyes contain separately selectable coats and optical structures; transparent materials are illustrative, without optical simulation. Middle and inner ear tissues are absent. The lymphoid layer contains 158 named groups of lymph nodes and two palatine tonsils, without collecting vessels or lymphatic ducts. Skin is a single external surface. Added nerves and lymph nodes use approximate alignment between atlases; local dimensions and contacts are not clinically validated.

Additional BodyParts3D surfaces: eyes and orbital supports, external ears, brain structures, blood vessels, selected connective tissues, skin and hair. Source layout retained, with surfaces simplified for mobile; bilingual original summaries and illustrative materials added. Four right eye surfaces contain tiny isolated fragments in the opposite orbit; only those documented fragments were removed. Duplicate vascular variants were excluded; ascending lumbar vein sides were corrected from geometry. Two epigastric venous portions retain uncertain identities. Additional Z-Anatomy surfaces: eight trunk muscles, 247 nervous structures and 160 lymphoid structures. Trunk muscles and lymphoid structures retain their source shapes with uniform scaling and rigid alignment. Nerves use a continuous bone-guided pose adjustment that can change local dimensions. Detailed inventories, exclusions, transformations and measured limitations are recorded in the bundled provenance file.
